card.law_is_about: Telecom-network reform; this supplementary proposal seeks stronger protection against fraudulent calls.
card.they_want: Obligatory telecom authentication and fraud-detection measures.
card.they_claim: About EUR 4 billion of 2025 European damage arose from social-engineering attacks, citing the EBA/ECB 2025 report.
card.the_problem: The named report measures 2022-2024, and its approximately EUR 4 billion headline covers all payment fraud. Attribution to social engineering remains unresolved.

claim_quote.original: im Jahr 2025 europaweit ca. vier Milliarden Euro an Schäden
claim_quote.translation_en: Translation: in 2025 across Europe approximately four billion euros in damage

request_quote.original: moderne Authentifizierungs- und Erkennungsverfahren flächendeckend einzusetzen
request_quote.translation_en: Translation: to deploy modern authentication and detection procedures comprehensively
request_quote.context: The surrounding sentence asks that telecom providers be obliged and legally enabled to deploy these procedures.

counter_quote.original: The total value of fraudulent payment transactions reported by the industry across the European Economic Area (EEA) amounted to EUR 4.2 billion in 2024.

locator.section: 2. Levels of payment fraud, first sentence

effect: The report cannot establish a 2025 loss measurement. Its headline does not itself quantify losses caused by spoofing or social engineering.
limits: This does not prove that actual 2025 losses were lower, or that telecom authentication is unnecessary. Social engineering can also obtain credentials used later by a fraudster, so the narrower payer-manipulation category is not a complete counter-total. The response acknowledges existing legal protections. No intent inferred.
correction: Cite the report as 2024 reported payment-fraud data and distinguish transaction value from booked losses. Keep the claimed social-engineering share open pending a source that measures the broader attack mechanism.

source_context.read_extent: All three author pages. Primary report cover, pages 6-10, 19-22, 34 and 47-49, with adjacent category and data-quality qualifications; not the full 49-page report. Author page 2 and report page 10 visually checked.
source_context.report_definition_limit: Page 34 separately reports booked losses and their bearing parties; those can occur in a different period from the fraudulent payment. Thus the headline transaction value cannot automatically be called final net damage.
source_context.source_inference: The submission expressly names EBA/ECB 2025 Report on Payment Fraud. The exact EUR 4.2 billion headline is a plausible basis for its rounded four-billion claim, not an authenticated reconstruction of the author’s calculation.

draft.version: No specific pending draft edition named. The document addresses the TKG after its March 2026 amendment and proposes added fraud protection.
draft.addressed_process_evidence: Register RV0019443 links the response to proposals for fraud prevention in the TKG reform; body pages 2-3 ground the supplementary request.
draft.limit: Do not substitute the later September Bundestag bill for an author-addressed exact draft or claim a wrong description of its operative provisions. Exact pending-version link remains unresolved.

submission_metadata.author: Die Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft, BVR-led joint position
submission_metadata.date_qualification: Register self-reports sending to Bundestag, BMF and BMDS on 20 August; this is distinct from 28 July author date and September publication. No independent recipient receipt.
submission_metadata.copy_evidence: All five PDF text extracts have identical whole-document hashes after whitespace removal; covers and body constitute one authored version.

confidence.text_source_mismatch: high for measurement year; unresolved for causal share

ai_reviews.outcome: Keep unresolved minor/null; broader social-engineering mechanisms and booked-loss definitions prevent a proved aggregate causal error.

history.event: First recorded as an unresolved source-scope lead; no major finding asserted

materiality_explanation: The chronology mismatch alone is minor. A proved attribution of the whole aggregate to an addressable attack type could matter more, but that broader inference is not established.

materiality_analysis.explanation: The chronology mismatch alone is minor. A proved attribution of the whole aggregate to an addressable attack type could matter more, but that broader inference is not established.
materiality_analysis.direction_explanation: Unknown: the headline scale supports reform rhetoric, but the effect of the one-year correction on the requested legal duties is unclear.
materiality_analysis.strongest_alternative: The report publication year may have been copied accidentally, and social engineering may describe a broader causal route than payer manipulation. Rounded booked losses also approach EUR 4 billion.
